text: The captain was upright at 2 s and then slumped with his head dropped and hands off the controls. Crosscheck said "Captain, are you OK?" at 21 s after seeing the slumped posture. The captain answered at 28 s that he was fine just reaching for his pen, and the watch flag was cleared shortly after.
